payload.code:
sudo cp $VAGRANTDIR/poppch20.conf /etc/httpd/conf.d/
systemctl start httpd
systemctl enable httpd

payload.markdown: I copy the configuration file into place and restart the web server so that the configuration is picked up. I also run systemctl enable to ensure that the server will be started at boot time.

payload.markdown: It’s important to note that those parts of the setup script we previously covered will also be rerun. When you create a provisioning script, you must design it so it can be executed repeatedly without serious repercussions. Luckily, Yum detects that my specified packages have already been installed and grumbles harmlessly, in part because I take the precaution of passing it -q flag, which keeps the complaints relatively muted.

items: Design Principles: Guidelines such as SOLID that keep object designs flexible.
Error Handling: Responding to PHP errors and warnings without letting the request die.
Error Patterns: Repeatable strategies: fail fast, wrap and rethrow, aggregate and report.
Return Types: The declared type of a function's return value.
Unit of Work: Tracking changes to many objects and writing them in a single transaction.
